question.text: A PSU has an EPS of Rs. 22 over the last 3 years. Under the DPE composite scoring system, how many points does it score on the EPS parameter?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.220, the DPE composite-indicators table assigns 8 points to EPS in the range greater than or equal to 20 and less than 30. EPS of Rs. 22 falls within this bracket and therefore scores 8 points. The Trap: Other options misread the bracket: 10 points is for EPS greater than or equal to 30, while 6 points is for EPS greater than or equal to 10 and less than 20. Note: The EPS parameter carries a weightage of 10 in the DPE composite indicators table on p.220.
